title: 'Deleted for good' is not quite true for a removed workout photo
what: Removing a workout photo asks 'It is deleted from this workout and from the app for good.' Two gaps. A backup file the member saved earlier still holds the photo, and restoring that backup puts it back on the workout. And the app deletes the photo's record first and the picture file second; if the file delete fails, the failure is only logged, the member is told nothing, and the start-up clean-up never finds the file again because it looks for records, not files. The picture then stays in the app's folder until 'Erase all data'.
expected: The words match what happens: say that copies in backups you saved before are not touched, and make sure a picture file whose delete failed is cleaned up later (or the member is told).
who: members who remove a workout photo
how_often: rare: only after restoring an older backup, or when a file delete fails
fix_line: Add 'copies in backups you saved before stay there' to the remove pop-up, and have the start-up clean-up also delete workout photo files that no record points at.

items.reason: P-A7-phone-watch-2-72 ('deleted for good'): partly kept, finding 01. P-A7-phone-watch-2-73 ('Private: they stay on this phone'): kept; workout photos are left out of the saved copy on MettleUp's server and of Android's automatic Google backup (both rule files list only the photo-backup folder, which holds progress photos); they leave the phone only in the member's own backup file or share picture, both started by the member and saying photos go in. P-A7-phone-watch-2-71 ('body weight stays private and is never shown'): kept on this screen; the line shows a level word only and the meanings carry no number that divides back to body weight. The share-picture body-weight leak is already FN-A5-phone-tracker-lib-4-02 (another area).

Notice: the privacy notice says everything logged stays on the phone unless it says otherwise; workout photos are not named but are covered and do stay. Consent: the camera asks the phone's permission first; a refusal shows words and an Open settings button. Sleep (Lighter-day line) is read in memory only, matching the notice. Deletion: see finding 01. Breach timing and children: nothing in these screens collects age or handles breaches.
these are phone screens that read only the phone's own data; no MettleUp staff view or read log lives here
Workout photos go with their workout and with 'Erase all data'; a file whose delete failed can outlive its record (finding 01). The items list names no entity with a kept-for period in this area.

No network call in these files. Sharing (picture, text, routine) opens the phone's share menu, chosen by the member. The trainer video opens a YouTube link and sends nothing. The 'AI coach notes' switch shows only while the hidden coach is on; the coach's sending is already FN-L4-phone-components-1-01. Sleep from Health Connect stays in memory, matching the notice.

'Erase all data' deletes the whole workout-photos folder; deleting a workout deletes its photos (rows and files). Workout photos are in no server or Google backup, so nothing is left there. Copies in a backup file the member saved stay with the member (finding 01). Deleting the MettleUp account itself is not in this area.
